C-INFRA-CI-TOOLCHAIN-BOOTSTRAP-20260831.Summary: Bootstrap and guarantee declared Rust toolchain 1.98.0, components rustfmt/clippy, and target wasm32-unknown-unknown for clean hosted runners and local environments.
C-INFRA-CI-TOOLCHAIN-BOOTSTRAP-20260831.Problem: Fresh GitHub Actions runners fail on first run because rustfmt, clippy, or the wasm32-unknown-unknown target are not provisioned by default for Rust 1.98.0.

Goals.Goal: Declare toolchain requirements explicitly in rust-toolchain.toml.
Update GitHub pull-request and master workflows to bootstrap toolchain before invoking test suites.

Constraints.Constraint: Declarative toolchain specification in rust-toolchain.toml declares channel 1.98.0, components rustfmt and clippy, and target wasm32-unknown-unknown.
Repository-owned bootstrap script scripts/ci/Initialize-WorldlineCi.ps1 ensures declared toolchain, components and targets are installed before test execution.
GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/pr.yml and master.yml) remain thin orchestration calling Initialize-WorldlineCi.ps1 and Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1.
No green by skipping: toolchain bootstrap and test gates fail closed with explicit diagnostics if requirements cannot be satisfied.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Installing external OS-level package managers or non-Rust tools.
Changing GitHub Actions runner images away from ubuntu-24.04.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: rust-toolchain.toml specifies channel 1.98.0, components [rustfmt, clippy], and targets [wasm32-unknown-unknown].
scripts/ci/Initialize-WorldlineCi.ps1 verifies and provisions the exact declared toolchain, components, and targets.
.github/workflows/pr.yml and .github/workflows/master.yml invoke Initialize-WorldlineCi.ps1 in every CI job after checkout.
scripts/ci/Test-WorldlineArchitecture.ps1 validates Initialize-WorldlineCi.ps1 as a required CI artifact.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Repository-owned toolchain bootstrap script successfully validates or installs rustfmt, clippy, and wasm32-unknown-unknown target; workflows invoke initialization before running test suites; local and architecture verification passes completely.

Assumptions.Assumption: GitHub Actions runners have rustup installed and available in PATH.
